title: Lesson 1 Quiz: What AI Is — and What It Isn't

questions.text: Which statement best describes an algorithm in the context of financial calculations?
options: A system that learns from past data to adjust its outputs.
A fixed step‑by‑step procedure for solving a problem.
A process that runs automatically without human intervention.
A technology that recommends products based on user behavior.
questions.explanation: An algorithm is a defined sequence of steps to perform a calculation.

questions.text: True or false: Artificial intelligence systems can modify their behavior based on new data.
questions.explanation: AI learns from data and can adjust its behavior.
